description: Provision a new webhook endpoint (a "bucket") that captures incoming HTTP requests. Start here when building, testing or debugging a webhook handler. Works with NO account and no API key: in that case it returns endpoint_id (use it as bucket_id), ingest_url (point the provider at it), inbox_url (the live view to hand the human) and api_token — pass that api_token as the `token` argument of the event, replay and delivery tools. A keyless bucket and its token expire after 3 days and every keyless call mints a new one (5 per hour), so call this once and reuse the result. With an API key it instead returns id, url, inbox_url and the signing secret, the bucket is permanent, and external_ref — your own stable name like "acme-api:stripe" — lets you re-find it later with list_buckets.

external_ref.description: Your own stable identifier (unique per account) for idempotent re-provisioning and re-finding.

name.description: Human label for the bucket. Ignored without an API key.

provider.description: The provider you are integrating (stripe, github, ...). Used only without an API key, as a hint.

name: create_bucket
